use_mass_app.label: Use Music Assistant Cast App
use_mass_app.description:
By default, Music Assistant will use a special Music Assistant Cast Receiver app to play media on cast devices. It is tweaked to provide better metadata and future expansion. 

If you want to use the official Google Cast Receiver app instead, disable this option, for example if your device has issues with the Music Assistant app.
